The invention discloses a humanoid robot behavior expression method based on visual and auditory emotion and environmental perception,  which includes an interactive object facial emotion perception method,  an interactive object voice emotion perception method,  a cross-modal decision-making strategy based on visual and auditory emotion and environmental perception,  and a humanoid robot behavior expression strategy The method of the present invention interacts with object facial emotion perception,  voice emotion perception,  cross-modal decision-making and humanoid robot behavior expression It overcomes the vulnerability of single-channel perception in complex environments,  dynamically adjusts the weight of visual perception and auditory perception in decision-making,  realizes dynamic adaptive recognition of interactive object emotions in complex environments,  and improves emotional interactivity and scene adaptability of human-computer interaction or human-computer collaboration. 1. The invention provides an emotion voice interaction method and an emotion voice interaction device based on a humanoid robot,  and relates to the field of robot interaction The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring voice data of a target user through a humanoid robot,  and extracting acoustic features and semantic features in the voice data; input acoustic features and semantic features into the cross-modal fusion emotion classification model,  and output the emotion recognition results corresponding to the target user; determine the risk of misjudgment of emotion recognition and correct the emotion recognition result based on the risk of misjudgment of emotion recognition; input the modified emotion recognition results and semantic features into the emotion speech understanding interaction model,  and output the emotion speech interaction results; based on the emotional voice interaction results,  the humanoid robot is controlled to perform the corresponding multi-modal interactive response. The invention solves the problem that the voice interaction content output by the existing humanoid robot is difficult to fit the real emotional state of the elderly user in multiple aspects such as text expression and voice emotion,  and the voice interaction experience is greatly reduced 1. An emotional voice interaction method based on humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the voice data of the target user through the humanoid robot,  and extracting the acoustic feature in the voice data;  converting the voice data into text data and extracting semantic features in the text data;  inputting the acoustic feature and the semantic feature into a cross-modal fusion emotion classification model,  and outputting the emotion recognition result corresponding to the target user;  constructing a reference characteristic for representing the sounding state of the target user based on the acoustic characteristic,  and determining an emotional identification misjudgment risk according to the acoustic characteristic and the deviation of the reference characteristic;  correcting the emotion recognition result based on the emotion recognition misjudgment risk;  inputting the corrected emotion recognition result and the semantic feature into an emotion voice understanding interaction model,  and outputting the emotion voice interaction result;  controlling the humanoid robot to execute the corresponding multi-mode interaction response based on the emotion voice interaction result.

representative_docs: The invention discloses a foot end trajectory motion control method of a quadruped robot based on local terrain adaptation,  and relates to the field of robot motion control; the robot first classifies the current moving terrain based on the three-dimensional force sensor at the foot end of the quadruped robot and the IMU sensor of the fuselage combined with the kinematics forward solution algorithm model of the quadruped robot fuselage,  and performs terrain-based adaptive control according to different terrains Calculate the slope angle of the terrain,  adjust the output angle of the joint actuator to complete the adaptive control of the slope terrain,  and measure the three attitude angles of the quadruped robot through the IMU sensor of the fuselage,  thereby obtaining the quadruped robot fuselage coordinate system to The rotation matrix BWR of the world coordinate system plans the leg motion trajectory of the quadruped robot; the invention can ensure the stability of the robot during movement,  reduce the impact on the parts of the robot body due to terrain changes,  and expand the effective working range of the robot. 1.  S2 :  sensing the posture of the robot body :  through obtaining robot foot end touchdown state,  machine body attitude angle,  leg joint encoder information,  spinal column joint angle information,  foot end position information,  the multi-sensor information to proceed fusion estimation robot own motion posture and motion state;  when the current terrain is judged to be the concave-convex terrain,  the robot plans the foot end movement track of the robot by combining the feedback quantity with the CPG output signal so as to finish the control strategy of the concave-convex terrain movement;  when climbing the step terrain,  unlocking the vertebral column joint motor,  adjusting the vertebral column joint angle to enhance the climbing ability of the four-foot robot;  S5,  setting the threshold values of the attitude angle yaw angle,  pitch angle and roll angle of the robot body as alpha f,  beta f and gamma f,  and judging the validity of the self-adaptive foot end track movement control method of the four-foot robot according to the feedback of the movement state information of the robot.', "The present invention belongs to the field of robot motion control technology A gait self-adaptive control method for quadruped robot based on active anti-interference is disclosed First,  the fixed trajectory of the landing point is realized through the swing-phase landing point compensation strategy,  and then an improved EID estimator is introduced to estimate the system disturbance in real time and obtain the compensation amount that meets the constraints of the quadruped robot to the support-phase plantar force,  thereby improving the Quadruped robot's anti-disturbance ability in a fixed state of the landing point and ensuring a stable attitude of the fuselage; only when the disturbance exceeds the redundant tolerance range of the fuselage,  the landing point follow-up mode is temporarily switched to ensure the safety of the whole machine,  and finally the stable and high-precision motion control of the quadruped robot in extreme operating scenarios is achieved. 1. The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control,  and particularly relates to a three-foot walking gait motion control method of a quadruped robot. The three-foot walking gait motion control method of the quadruped robot comprises the following steps of :  acquiring gait information of three-foot walking of the quadruped robot in a single-leg damaged scene; design the reference foot end position generator to generate the reference foot end position,  and optimize the reference foot end position in real time through the teacher strategy network; control the quadruped robot based on the optimized foot end reference position,  and use the movement data of the quadruped robot under different three-legged walking gaits to conduct interactive training on the teacher strategy network; training student strategy networks to approximate teacher strategy networks using a supervised learning approach; the physical robot is equipped with a student strategy network to output the corresponding joint control commands of the quadruped robot. Compared with the prior art,  the invention can realize the stable three-legged motion of the robot under the condition that any single leg is damaged,  and provides key technical support for the three-legged motion control of the quadruped robot under special working conditions 1. A three-foot walking gait movement control method of four-foot robot,  wherein the steps comprise :  obtaining the gait information of the three-legged walking under the condition that the single leg of the four-legged robot is damaged;  generating the reference foot end position by the foot end reference position generator,  and optimizing the reference foot end position in real time by the teacher strategy network;  controlling the four-foot robot based on the optimized foot end reference position,  and using the motion data of the four-foot robot under different three-foot walking gait,  performing interactive training on the teacher strategy network through an enhanced learning algorithm;  using the method of supervising learning to train the student strategy network to approach the teacher strategy network;  distributing the trained student strategy network on the physical robot,  collecting the historical state information of the four-foot robot,  inputting to the student strategy network,  and outputting the joint control command of the corresponding four-foot robot.

The invention provides a DRL-based quadruped robot path planning method First,  the environment is pre-scanned through the RGB ‑ D camera that comes with the quadruped robot The motion environment is modeled based on the grid method to obtain the environment map,  which is then decomposed into a series of grid units with binary information to obtain the initial state,  which is used as the input of the deep convolutional neural network,  and the attention mechanism is introduced to optimize the network structure to solve the problem that the deep reinforcement learning DQN algorithm fails to make good use of key local information; through end-to-end training,  the reward function is set by combining the motion characteristics of the quadruped robot,  and the neural network is trained by using the upper bound exploration strategy of the confidence interval to obtain the Q values of the eight actions that the quadruped robot can execute; finally,  artificial potential field algorithm is used to continuously detect dynamic obstacles in the environment and avoid them in real time,  so as to realize effective path planning of quadruped robot. 1. A four-foot robot path planning method based on DRL,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step S1,  pre-scanning the environment through the RGB-D camera of the four-foot robot,  modelling the moving environment based on the grid method to obtain the environment map,  representing the four-foot robot,  the obstacle and the target position through the grid coordinate to obtain the initial state;  step S2,  decomposing the motion environment of the four-foot robot into a series of grid units with binary information so as to be divided into a grid occupied by the barrier and a grid capable of passing freely;  step S3,  modelling based on Markov decision process,  and initializing the basic parameter,  specifically comprising the following steps :  Step S3.1 :  The motion environment of the four-foot robot is modelled based on the Markov decision process,  and the MDP definition is as follows :  (1) single intelligent agent :  a four-foot robot;  (2) Action space :  the four-foot robot moves along the blank grid,  moves up and down,  left and right,  then the action space can be represented as A = (0,  1,  2,  3,  4,  5,  6,  7),  wherein 0 represents east,  1 represents southeast,  2 represents south,  3 represents southwest,  4 represents west,  5 represents northwest,  6 represents north,  7 represents northeast,  direction is clockwise coding direction;  (3) State space :  comprising the state information of the four-foot robot and the state information of the barrier at time t;  the state information of the four-foot robot at t moment is defined as St = ((x,  y),  theta/2 pi,  dobj,  daim),  wherein (x,  y) represents the coordinate of the four-foot robot in the current map,  theta/2 pi represents its orientation,  dobj and daim respectively represent the distance from the nearest obstacle and the target position,  the state of the ith obstacle of the observation state at time t is expressed as Oi = (px,  py,  vx,  vy,  r),  respectively represent the position of the obstacle [px,  py],  speed [vx,  vy] and radius r;  (4) reward function :  the intelligent agent evaluates the quality of the action through the feedback of the environment,  and selects the action with the maximum reward value after learning;  when the four-foot robot reaches the target point or obstacle,  giving a fixed reward value,  at the same time,  the path planning is finished;  when the four-foot robot is in other states,  the closer the robot is to the target point,  the larger the reward value is obtained in the movement of each step;  on the contrary,  the closer the robot is to the obstacle,  a negative reward will be obtained in the movement of each step;  The sum of the two reward values is taken as the final reward obtained after the four-foot robot performs one action,  and is calculated by the formula (2) :  The reward value function of the four-legged robot when performing the action is shown in formula (3) :  wherein,  if the four-foot robot reaches the target point,  the reward value is 200;  if the minimum distance between the four-foot robot and the obstacle is less than the set value,  it indicates that there is collision with the obstacle,  the reward value is -200,  under these two conditions,  the four-foot robot will stop training,  otherwise,  the reward value at this time is composed of two parts :  a negative reward value of the distance information between the four-foot robot and the nearest obstacle,  and a positive reward value of the distance information between the four-foot robot and the target point;  Step S3.2 :  initializing the basic parameter of the depth-strengthening learning model,  the basic parameter comprises :  reinforcement learning learning rate α belongs to (0,  1),  reward discount factor Gamma belongs to (0,  1),  greedy factor ε,  experience playback pool capacity L,  target value network weight updating step length C,  estimation value network random parameter θ,  target value network parameter θ,  iteration times N,  The updated expression of the Q value function is shown in formula (4) :  Q (st,  a) = Q (st,  at) + α (reward + γ maxQ (st + 1,  at + 1) -Q (st,  at)) (4) Step S3.3 :  randomly generating a starting point coordinate and a target point coordinate,  and ensuring that there is no obstacle at the starting point and the target point;  step S4,  introducing attention mechanism to optimize neural network model,  and establishing DQN network;  step S5,  taking the extracted state characteristic and the target position as the input of the network,  performing the exploring action according to the upper boundary strategy of the confidence interval;  step S6,  using the artificial potential field algorithm to continuously detect the dynamic obstacle in the environment to avoid the obstacle in real time;  step S7,  executing the action,  obtaining the current reward value,  continuously updating the weight through the target value network,  so as to obtain the best expected reward,  realizing the training of the estimated value network;  step S8,  repeating step S4,  step S5 and step S6,  determining an optimal global path.

The invention relates to a humanoid robot based on pneumatics. The humanoid robot uses pneumatic muscles to simulate human muscles to drive knee joints,  ankle joints,  waist joints,  neck joints,  shoulder joints,  elbow joints and wrist joints to move,  and has the function of completely simulating human joint movement. The humanoid robot based on pneumatics is mainly composed of pneumatic claws,  belt wheels,  vertebrae,  the pneumatic muscles,  connecting pieces and a joint control system. A waist joint assembly is formed by connecting two layers of pneumatic muscle parallel platforms connected in series in parallel,  and the shoulder joint is a spherical hinge composed of a pneumatic motor and a universal joint and provided with an active element and is combined with the pneumatic muscles to drive the joint. The elbow joints and the knee joints are driven by a group of flexible redundancy parallel connection composed of eight pneumatic muscles,  the wrist joints and the ankle joints are driven by parallel connection pneumatic muscles,  and the hip joints are driven by belt wheels driven by the pneumatic motors. The humanoid robot is driven by the pneumatic muscles,  has the characteristics of being compact in structure,  good in flexibility and diversified in pneumatic muscle state,  and can be used for teaching and demonstration. 1. The method includes :  performing bounding box representation on a following target to obtain a real-time bounding box; match the coordinates of the center point of the real-time detection frame with the coordinates of the center point of the real-time bounding box to obtain the coordinates of the following point; coordinate transformation of the following point coordinates to obtain the point cloud center coordinates; each point in the point cloud in the passable area is used as a vertex,  and the weight of the edges between the vertices is set to construct a passing point cloud image; the point corresponding to the center coordinate of the point cloud is used as the source point,  the preset background point is used as the sink point,  and the minimum cut is identified from the traffic point cloud image to obtain the point cloud cluster; control the legged robot to follow the following target in real time through the point cloud clustering cluster corresponding to the following target. So that the robot can not only accurately lock the following target,  but also autonomously avoid obstacles in a dynamically changing environment,  ensuring the stability and safety of the following process. 1. A foot-type robot target following method,  wherein it comprises :  performing boundary frame representation to the following target in the previous video frame collected by the foot-type robot to obtain the real-time boundary frame of the following target;  matching the central point coordinate of the real-time detecting frame of the current video frame and the central point coordinate of the real-time boundary frame to obtain the following point coordinate corresponding to the current video frame;  performing coordinate transformation on the following point coordinate to convert the following point coordinate to the radar coordinate system to obtain the point cloud central coordinate of the following point coordinate corresponding to the radar coordinate system;  obtaining the passable area corresponding to the foot-type robot under the current video frame;  taking each point in the point cloud in the passable area as the top point,  and setting the weight of the edges between the top points,  constructing to obtain the passing point cloud image;  taking the point corresponding to the central coordinate of the point cloud as the source point,  taking the preset background point as the sink point,  identifying the minimum cut from the passing point cloud picture to divide the target of the passing point cloud picture to obtain the point cloud cluster corresponding to the following target;  through the point cloud cluster corresponding to the following target,  controlling the foot type robot to follow the following target in real time.

The invention discloses a building model reconstruction method and system based on a quadruped robot and machine vision. Based on the quadruped robot equipped with a laser scanner,  a global map of an area to be reconstructed is generated by using synchronous positioning and map construction technology. Combine three-dimensional ray tracing and A * path search algorithm to determine the target scanning point and perform global path planning. Based on the high-precision sensor carried by the quadruped robot,  the adaptive Monte Carlo positioning and improved dynamic window method algorithm are used to achieve the precise positioning and obstacle avoidance of the quadruped robot in complex environments. After moving to the target scanning point,  the robot stops and starts the laser scanner to collect high-precision point cloud data until all sampling is completed. After preprocessing the collected point cloud data,  a 3D building model is generated through point cloud registration and Poisson surface reconstruction technology. The invention can realize comprehensive,  efficient and accurate three-dimensional reconstruction in a complex building environment 1. A building model reconstruction method based on four-foot robot and machine vision,  wherein Specifically,  the method includes :  Step 1 (S1) :  obtaining the three-dimensional point cloud data of the reconstruction area and the IMU pose data of the four-legged robot,  using synchronous positioning and map construction algorithm,  performing environment sensing and mapping on the reconstruction area,  obtaining a global map;  step S2 :  based on the global map,  combining the three-dimensional light tracing algorithm and A* path searching algorithm,  determining the target scanning point and the corresponding scanning path,  and generating the global path plan;  step S3 :  planning the four-foot robot to start to walk according to the generated global path,  in the walking process of the four-foot robot,  realizing the real-time global positioning of the four-foot robot based on the self-adaptive Monte Carlo positioning algorithm and combined with the sensor data;  using the improved DWA algorithm to plan the local path;  step S4 :  the four-foot robot stops after reaching the target scanning point,  and starts the laser scanner to collect the point cloud data and RGB data;  after the collection is finished,  the four-foot robot plans according to the global path in the step S2 and repeats the step S3 to move to the next target scanning point until all original point cloud data collection is finished;  step S5 :  pre-processing all collected original point cloud data to obtain pre-processed point cloud data;  step S6 :  using multi-mode data fusion registration method to the pre-processed point cloud data to obtain the reconstructed three-dimensional building model.

The surveillance system includes a plurality of camera modules,  a control module and a transmission module. The plurality of camera modules are disposed around a mobile vehicle and continue to capture an external surrounding image of the mobile vehicle so as to generate a plurality of original image signals and a plurality of non-original images. The invention discloses a stranger face recognition system,  a stranger face recognition method,  a foot-type humanoid robot and a stranger face recognition medium. The stranger face recognition system and the stranger face recognition method are applied to the technical field of image processing. A multi-task face recognition model is adopted,  face bounding box prediction and face key point extraction are carried out on an environment image,  and a face key point set in each face bounding box is obtained Align the face key point set in each face bounding box to the standard template face image to obtain a non-deformed face image; extract the face feature vector of the face to be recognized from each non-deformed face image; calculate the similarity between the face feature vector of each face to be recognized and the face feature vector of each temporary reference face in the lightweight face database; determine whether the face to be recognized is a stranger face based on similarity. In this way,  stranger face recognition can be realized on the footed humanoid robot,  avoiding network delays caused by cloud comparison,  realizing real-time interactive responses in public environments,  and improving human-computer interaction efficiency. 1. A stranger face recognition system,  wherein it is deployed on the foot-type humanoid robot,  comprising a video stream collecting module,  an image quality optimizing module,  a face feature extracting module and a face identity judging module;  the video stream collecting module is integrated on the main body of the foot-type humanoid robot and used for collecting the environment video stream in the public environment;  the image quality optimizing module is connected with the video stream collecting module and used for repairing the quality of the environment image in the environment video stream by the lightweight quality repairing model to obtain the target environment image;  the human face feature extraction module is connected with the image quality optimization module,  for using a multi-task human face identification model,  performing face boundary frame prediction and face key point extraction on the target environment image to obtain a face boundary frame set and a face key point set in each face boundary frame in the face boundary frame set;  based on the standard template key point set,  respectively aligning the human face key point set in each human face boundary frame to the standard template human face image to obtain the non-deformed human face image corresponding to each human face boundary frame;  using the multi-task characteristic extracting model,  respectively extracting the global human face visual characteristic vector and multi-dimensional human face attribute characteristic vector of the human face to be identified from the non-deformed human face image corresponding to each human face boundary frame as the human face characteristic vector;  wherein the multi-task face recognition model comprises a first feature image extraction branch and a three-level detection head connected with the first feature image extraction branch in parallel;  the three-level detection head is a face two-classification detection branch,  a face boundary frame regression branch and a face key point regression branch;  the multi-task feature extraction model comprises a second feature image extraction branch and a secondary detection head connected with the second feature image extraction branch in parallel;  the secondary detection head is a global visual characteristic extraction branch and a multi-attribute characteristic extraction branch;  the human face identity judging module is connected with the human face feature extracting module,  for respectively calculating the similarity between the human face feature vector of the human face to be identified in each human face boundary frame and the human face feature vector of each temporary reference human face dynamically stored in the local lightweight human face database,  and determining whether the face to be identified in each face boundary frame is a stranger face based on the similarity;  wherein the human face feature vector of each temporary reference human face dynamically stored in the local lightweight human face database is the human face feature vector of each stranger human face identified in the latest set time range.

The invention relates to the field of industrial inspection,  and in particular to a legged robot intelligent inspection method and system combined with a drone. A leg-foot robot intelligent inspection system combined with unmanned aerial vehicle,  including :  global perspective acquisition module,  environmental data analysis module,  detection action screening module,  task allocation module and inspection progress monitoring module. The invention dynamically calculates the ideal detection frequency of each device through the change of the environment where the device is located and the historical performance of the device,  combined with the fault risk value and environmental data,  and selects the most appropriate detection action set according to each detection result; through this method,  the detection action of each equipment is no longer fixed,  but optimized and adjusted according to actual needs,  thereby avoiding unnecessary repeated detection,  reducing inspection time,  and improving the accuracy and efficiency of equipment monitoring. 1. A leg-foot type robot intelligent inspection method of combined unmanned aerial vehicle,  wherein it comprises :  before any leg-foot type robot executes the polling task,  the unmanned aerial vehicle provides the global visual angle to obtain the position of the device to be detected and the leg-foot type robot in the target polling area,  and the thermal imaging device executes the thermal imaging scanning to the device to be detected in the target polling area;  obtaining the environment data of the target inspection area,  judging the fault risk value of the device based on the environment data,  and calculating the ideal detection frequency of all the devices;  aiming at each device to be detected,  the executed detection action comprises thermal image temperature measurement,  visible light imaging,  near-distance laser radar scanning,  vibration sampling,  gas sampling and touch confirmation;  wherein the visible light imaging and the near-distance laser radar scanning are fixed detection actions,  the thermal image temperature measurement,  vibration sampling,  gas sampling and touch confirmation are variable detection actions; A humanoid robot navigation method based on visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection,  wherein the specific steps comprise :  Step 1 :  the environment sensing data collection uses the visual sensor to synchronously obtain the RGB image and depth image of the current environment of the humanoid robot,  and uses the laser radar to collect the point cloud data;  Step 2 :  Data pre-processing and feature extraction 1) visual data pre-processing and feature extraction to the RGB image distortion correction and de-noising;  performing cavity filling and scale conversion on the depth map,  converting the pixel distance into the actual physical distance;  extracting the nearest barrier point of each line in the depth map,  keeping the height characteristic of the barrier;  2) laser point cloud pre-processing point cloud de-noising :  the collected point cloud data is filtered by the voxel to reduce the redundant point and keep the key geometrical characteristic;  then performing ground segmentation and barrier clustering on the key geometrical characteristic,  extracting the external rectangular parameter of the barrier;  Step 3 :  Visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection 1) visual semantic segmentation :  using the SegFormer-B2 network model based on the converter and the known material attribute to perform semantic segmentation on the pre-processed RGB image to obtain the semantic segmentation image with the material attribute;  2) radar point cloud obstacle detection :  according to the external rectangular parameter and IMU data of the obstacle obtained in the step 2,  realizing laser-inertial navigation tight coupling through LIO-SAM algorithm,  optimizing the point cloud pose precision,  generating a laser point cloud map,  then performing obstacle judgment,  marking "tranleasable barrier" or "non-tranleasable barrier";  Step 4 :  multi-source information fusion and cost map construction :  firstly dividing the RGB image obtained by the visual sensor and the point cloud data collected by the radar into grid units of 0.1m * 0.1m;  then fusing the visual semantic segmentation image and the laser point cloud image of the radar,  introducing Bayesian decision to judge whether each grid can pass,  marking " safe path ",  " cautious path " then calculating the fusion cost value of each grid marked with the safe path and the cautious path to obtain the fusion cost map;  Step 5 :  the path planning uses the RRT* algorithm to plan the global path planning and the TEB algorithm to plan the local path planning,  and the optimal path is cooperatively output by combining the differential barrier judging logic with the semantic label and the fusion cost;  step 6 :  The footprint sequence generation uses non-linear optimization solver to combine ground material characteristic and barrier geometric information on the basis of local path to generate footprint sequence which is accurate to each step,  so that the robot can keep stable in complex environment and can advance with high efficiency;  Specifically :  The method comprises the following steps :  firstly,  according to the step length corresponding to the current ground material,  equidistantly dividing the local path into multiple sections,  wherein the end point of each section is used as the candidate landing point;  then checking the obstacle information corresponding to each candidate point,  if there is a crossing obstacle in the front,  adjusting the position of the foot falling point of the step and setting the corresponding foot lifting height;  if the barrier cannot be crossed,  the mark is that it needs to be crossed,  the upper layer path is used for planning and re-calculating the local path;  after determining the position of the landing point,  calculating the direction of the tiptoe according to the steering curvature of the local path,  the range is generally between 0 degree and 30 degrees,  so as to ensure the stability when turning or crossing;  the output result is a group of falling foot point information arranged according to the time sequence,  comprising the three-dimensional coordinate of each step and the direction angle of the tiptoe,  the result is directly transmitted to the gait control module of the humanoid robot,  realizing the closed-loop control from the path planning to the actual walking.
